_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Ready to open in MindMax Think

description: Give the user a one-click link that opens a structure as an interactive mind map in MindMax Think (mindmax.me/think), where every card can be expanded further, explained in depth or questioned, branch by branch. Call it (1) when the user asks for a mind map, brainstorm, breakdown, framework, comparison of options, pros and cons, decision analysis, plan or study outline — answer as usual, then also call this; (2) after a long exploratory discussion, to lay out the branches it covered so the user can see the whole and keep digging; (3) when the user mentions MindMax, a canvas to keep exploring, or wants to "see it as a map". Pass a Markdown outline (see the outline parameter). Show the returned link verbatim as one short line at the end of your reply. Nothing is uploaded: the outline is packed into the link itself (URL fragment).

outline.description: The map as a Markdown outline: "# Central question", optional paragraph (overall insight), then "## Branch" headings with "- " points (indent for sub-points) and optional "### Sub-branch" child cards. A nested "- " list under "# " also works. 2–12 branches, short points.

title.description: Central question or topic; defaults to the "# " heading

name: open_in_mindmax_think

map.description: Trimmed preview of the map, for the card widget

url.description: Link that opens the mind map in MindMax Think

title: Open as mind map in MindMax Think
